subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. 

**Keen**
solution:
The correct answer is Eager.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Keen means having or showing eagerness or enthusiasm.

 
 
• Example: He's a keen student of art history.
 
 
 
• The marked option 'eager' means 'strongly wanting to do or have something'.
 
 
• Example: The man was eager to please.
 
 
 
• Therefore from the above mentioned points we can conclude that 'eager' and 'keen' are two similar words in meaning.
 
• Thus option 2 is the correct answer.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Jovial- Cheerful and friendly.
 
• Active- Engaging or ready to engage in physically energetic pursuits.
 
• Benign- Gentle and kindly.
